crossRefs.note: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.
The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.
The man Jeroboam was a mighty man of valor; and Solomon saw the young man that he was industrious, and he put him in…
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in…
“His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you…
“His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you…
not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

translations.web: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
translations.bsb: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will be stationed in the presence of kings; he will not stand before obscure men.
translations.kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean
translations.asv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; He shall not stand before mean men.
